description: This Java source file defines the ShippingConfiguration class, which models various shipping options and configurations for an e-commerce system. It includes fields for shipping type, basis, package type, description, free shipping options, and related financial details, with methods for JSON serialization and property management.

classes.name: ShippingConfiguration
classes.description: A class representing shipping configurations, including shipping types, options, packaging, descriptions, free shipping conditions, and related costs, with capability to serialize to JSON.

methods.name: getShipType
methods.description: Returns the string representing the shipping type.

methods.name: setShipType
methods.description: Sets the shipping type based on a string input, updating the corresponding enum.

methods.name: toJSONString
methods.description: Serializes the shipping configuration data into a JSON string.
